text:
matt.h: Heads-up — were investigating an incident in ap-southeast1. Several customers using rerank/quality routes observed degraded output quality (short, repetitive, or incorrect reorderings) starting ~03:07 SGT. Latency and error rates look normal. Opening incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3321001234

sre-ana: Confirmed signal in eval telemetry: rerank score distributions shifted for a subset of requests routed to fallback model variant (quantized-x-small) after an automated capacity fallback at 03:05. Looks like capacity pressure caused smart-routing to pick a lower-fidelity model that has different scoring behavior.

eng-runtime-ravi: We saw a flurry of autoscaler evictions on a dedicated pool that feeds ap-southeast1 around 03:03, which triggered fallback policy to cheaper variants. Root cause of eviction still unknown.

cs-juno: Getting customer reports: org-311 & org-522 flagged decreased rerank quality in production. Theyve already opened support tickets. Flagging for proactive outreach.

sre-ana: Immediate mitigation: pin routing policy for rerank routes in ap-southeast1 to avoid automatic fallback to quantized variants. Applying canary (10%) now, then ramp. Also re-instate reserve pool to handle transient autoscaler churn.

ops-bot: action: routing-pin/ap-southeast1/rerank=fallback-disabled canary=10% started at 3321001242

eng-runtime-ravi: Canary telemetry (5m): affected rerank-score drift reduced by ~95% on canary traffic. No latency regressions. Rolling to 100% over next 8m.

sre-ana: Reserve pool scaled up + eviction mitigation applied. Monitoring for further autoscaler churn and queueing.

status-page-bot: Public status posted: "Investigating We are investigating reports of quality degradation for some rerank requests in ap-southeast1. A mitigation is being rolled out to pin model selection while we investigate. More updates to follow." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3321001234

eng-runtime-ravi: 100% pin complete at 3321001288. Quality telemetry back within expected bounds for rerank traffic. Keeping incident open for 15m of monitoring and customer confirmations.

cs-juno: Reaching out to affected customers with explanation and timeframe. Suggest offering short-term credits for impacted queries over the 45m window.

sre-ana: Owners for RCA: eng-runtime (ravi) to fix model selection race and autoscaler interaction, eng-sre (ana) to investigate eviction cascade, customer-success (juno) for comms. Action items: 1) postmortem within 72h, 2) add canary gate that blocks fallback to smaller model variants for quality-sensitive routes, 3) add alert for autoscaler eviction storms.

matt.h: Thanks team. Final public update after monitoring window. If any customer escalations, page oncall. :thumbsup:
